item.title: MI refuses RCB NOC to use DY Patil Stadium as home base for IPL 2026; tells them to explore other venues- Report
item.description: The Mumbai Indians (MI) have reportedly refused to grant the Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) a No Objection Certificate (NOC) to host their IPL 2026 matches at the DY Patil Sports Academy in Navi Mumbai. In January, reports suggested that RCB, who lifted the IPL 2025 trophy, were reluctant to return to their home ground, the M Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru, following the Bengaluru stampede, and were keen to stage their home games at the Navi Mumbai venue. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Pakistan media uses Rajeev Shukla’s fake AI clip to mock BCCI before IND v PAK game; Shukla rebukes claims
item.description: BCCI Vice-President Rajeev Shukla chastised a Pakistani TV outlet for a viral AI-morphed video of his comments on the India-Pakistan T20 World Cup 2026 match.
